player_prompt.intro:
Udlala Tower of Hanoi ene-{num_disks} disks.
Kufuneka usithe disks ezikusuka kwenye tower A ukuya kwenye tower C.
Ukuze usithe disk, bhala ithe tower esiyintsusa neye ithe tower oyikhuphela kuyo (njenge, '[A C]').
Qaphela ukuba ungasiyithe kuphela i-disk e-phezulu ye-tower, kwaye i-disk enkulu hayiwezi kuwehliswa phezu kwe-disk encinci.
Kwakhona ngoku, ngenisa isithuko esinye.

invalid_move.invalid_tower: Uchaze umthombo ongasebenziyo okanye inqaba ekujoliswe kuyo.
invalid_move.same_tower: Uzamile ukuhambisa idiski kweso sakhiwo sinye.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Uzame ukubeka idiski enkulu kwidiskhi encinane.

game_action.moved: Uhambise idiski {disk} ukusuka ku-{source} ukuya kwi-{target}.

outcome.win: Ndiyakuvuyisana nawe, usombulule iphazili yeNqaba yaseHanoi.
outcome.turn_limit: Umda wenguqu ufikelelwe. Ubekwe ngokuchanekileyo {pct}% yeediski kwiNqaba C.
